products.name: Kore.ai
products.note: Enterprise agentic AI platform; multi-agent orchestration; comprehensive governance dashboard with audit logs, RBAC, and guardrails; 400+ Fortune 2000 customers

profile_text.body:
Kore.ai is an enterprise AI company whose website describes it as a leader in enterprise AI that helps businesses accelerate outcomes across customer service and employee productivity with agentic AI. The site lists the industries it serves as banking, wealth management, healthcare for payers, providers and life sciences, retail, telco, and travel and hospitality.

Its tracked product is an enterprise agentic AI platform of the same name, offering multi-agent orchestration and a governance dashboard with audit logs, role-based access control, and guardrails. The company reports 400+ Fortune 2000 customers. No litigation or MCP server records are held for it.
